description: Generate an expanded image around the original content using target width, height, and optional prompt.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the image to expand. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Optional prompt describing the extended scene.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
